name: greener
description: A Claude plugin and remote MCP server that helps Australian land holders increase the biodiversity of their site.

scripts.dev: npm run build:index && npm run dev -w server
scripts.check: npm run check:kb && npm run build:index && npm run check:lint && npm run check:types && npm test -w server -- --coverage && npm run check:docs && npm run check:audit
scripts.check:types: tsc -p server/tsconfig.json && tsc -p server/ui/tsconfig.json && tsc -p scripts/tsconfig.json
scripts.test: npm run build:index && npm test -w server
scripts.deploy:staging: npm run build:index && npm run deploy -w server -- --env staging
scripts.test:coverage: npm run build:index && npm test -w server -- --coverage --project unit
